fit_validation.method: Exact normalized two-type Moran mean-field; pseudo-Huber endpoint logit loss, delta=1; s2 nonnegative; baseline conditioned on observed positive VAF.
fit_validation.growth_approximation: mu=0 and initial D=0 for conditional growth fitting only; risk scenarios independently allow mutation and pre-existing double hits.
fit_validation.uncertainty: Patient-cluster percentile bootstrap of gene summaries/contrasts; 60000 draws, seed20261105. No individual parameter confidence intervals.

fit_validation.bootstrap_absent_gene_handling: Gene summaries omit draws absent that gene; each contrast omits only draws absent either member. Effective counts are reported. Intervals condition on both genes being represented and are exploratory for small groups.
fit_validation.singleton_paired_comparison_handling: A single shared eligible patient yields a descriptive difference but no confidence interval; no shared eligible patients yields no paired estimate.
fit_validation.bootstrap_degeneracy_caution: A zero-width empirical resampling interval, especially with all estimates at the nonnegative boundary, does not establish precise zero biological effect.
limitations: Post-diagnosis endpoints remain in retrospective primary fits and are excluded in a separate sensitivity.
Zero and VAF>=50% endpoints are not assigned pseudocounts or capped; their patient/gene groups may be unfit.
Variants within a patient/gene share s2 but their clonal relationships are unresolved.
A deterministic nonnegative selection model cannot explain genuine contraction; boundary fits and residuals expose disagreement.
Fixed kinetics, LD, baseline burden, and unresolved sample-to-progenitor mapping limit interpretation.
No calibrated clinical tMN probability or gene-specific malignant-lineage attribution is inferred here.
Nonrandom endpoint eligibility can change gene rankings. Genes with three or four fitted patients and comparisons involving them are exploratory.
Bootstrap omission of gene-absent draws conditions intervals on representation. Nominal Bonferroni adjustment does not remove small-sample or selection bias; no hypothesis tests are claimed.

config.double_hit_definition: second transforming alteration; aggregate double-hit population
notes: Reference and sensitivity values are scenario assumptions, not measured progenitor parameters.
s_D is calculated as additional_rare_clone_growth_per_day divided by b; b*s_D is an approximate rare-clone growth scale, not an exact net growth rate in a mixed population.
Baseline D must not exceed total founder-marked burden and must be below 1001 for an initially event-free analysis.
Absence from tMN_VAF does not establish clinical event-free follow-up.
